data.name: Ardolino
data.gender_notes: Ardolino is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ardolino is a name of Italian origin, derived from the old Germanic words ‘ard’ meaning strong and ‘wolinn’ meaning eagle. The name Ardolino evokes images of courage, power, and nobility. Historically, it was common among the nobility in medieval Europe, particularly in Italy. The name Ardolino carries the meaning “Strong, eagle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ardolino usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, eagle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
